explanation: A title used to refer to God as the supreme authority and protector of humanity.
To put together or construct something; in this context, it refers to God's role in building and sustaining communities and families.
A person or power that protects and cares for something. In Psalm 127, this refers to God's role as the guardian of cities and people.
When something lacks meaning or purpose. In this psalm, it means that all human efforts are meaningless without God's involvement and blessing.
The effort and activities that people undertake to achieve a goal or earn their livelihood.
A natural state of rest in which the body and mind recover. In this psalm, sleep is a metaphor for trusting in God and recognizing that He provides what we need.
Offspring or descendants of a person. In Psalm 127, children symbolize God's blessings and rewards for those who trust and obey Him.
Slender, pointed projectiles shot from a bow. In this psalm, arrows represent children as protection and strength for parents.
Persons or forces that oppose or threaten someone. In this context, enemies refer to the powers that work against God's will and plans.
